LeverageImpact.description:
Gross-leverage impact of a liability management exercise.

Leverage is gross debt over EBITDA, so a value of `8.0` reads as 8.0x.
Only debt retired at par reduces leverage; consent fees and collateral
transfers leave gross debt unchanged.

post_leverage.description: Gross debt over EBITDA after the exercise, as a multiple.

post_total_debt.description: Gross debt of the target instrument after the exercise.

pre_leverage.description: Gross debt over EBITDA before the exercise, as a multiple.

pre_total_debt.description: Gross debt of the target instrument before the exercise.

LmeType.description:
Structure of a liability management exercise.

Each variant reinterprets the `repurchase_price_pct` argument of
[`analyze_lme`]; see that function's documentation for the per-variant
meaning and admissible range.

oneOf.description: Open-market repurchase of debt below par.
Public tender offer for debt at a stated price.
Maturity extension in exchange for a consent fee; no par is retired.

Transfer of collateral to an unrestricted subsidiary; no par is
retired and remaining holders are structurally diluted.

description: Issuer-side economics of a liability management exercise.

cost.description: Cash paid by the issuer, in the caller's monetary unit.

discount_capture.description: Par retired less cash paid — the discount captured by the issuer.

discount_capture_pct.description:
Discount captured as a fraction of par retired; zero when no par is
retired.

leverage_impact.description: Gross-leverage impact, present only when a positive EBITDA is supplied.

lme_type.description: Structure of the exercise, echoed back in canonical form.

notional_reduction.description: Face amount retired; zero for structures that do not extinguish debt.

remaining_holder_impact_pct.description:
Fraction of value diverted away from non-participating holders; nonzero
only for a [`LmeType::Dropdown`].
